other_failure_modes.name: Target encoding data leakage during CV
other_failure_modes.description: Out-of-fold target encoding is performed prior to the main model cross-validation loop. As a result, the encoded features for a given model training fold contain information aggregated from that model's validation fold targets. This causes target leakage that artificially inflates validation performance.

other_failure_modes.name: Feature distribution leakage during CV
other_failure_modes.description: Group aggregations (e.g., mean, std) and quantile transformations are fit on the entire training dataset before cross-validation. This leaks the statistical distribution of the validation folds into the training folds.

summary: The agent constructs a solid, high-capacity pipeline complete with robust data processing, multiple diverse models, and sophisticated rank ensembling optimized for the AUC metric. However, the implementation computes out-of-fold target encodings and global distribution transforms prior to the actual modeling cross-validation loop, introducing significant target and feature leakage across the CV folds.
